journal_lines: The passage opened into something vast. §oOld paper smell, dense, like a place that had been sealed a long time. Cannot read. Brought a page.
A library underground, sealed and dry. §oMost of the shelves had held. Most of the books had not. Took one that had.
Rows of books in stone alcoves. §oThe air was very still. Very old. Took one that felt different from the others.
Something lit the room that I could not find the source of. Did not look for it long. Took what I came for.
Brought back a §lbook§r whose cover was warm where nothing warm had any business being. Set it down carefully.
The shelves ran floor to ceiling. §oThe ceiling was higher than the door was wide. Did not think about it.
§oBinding glue and quiet years. The smell of it settled into the fur. Left with one volume and the smell.
Books in a language the stone seemed to know better than anyone living. Took one. Left the rest undisturbed.
